title: AthleteProfile
description: Who the runner is. Slowly changing and fully versioned: every edit becomes a profile_revision event, because plan generation must remain explainable months later. Paces and fitness are NOT stored here — they are derived evidence with their own confidence and expiry (pace_estimates, metric-definitions.md).

revision.description: Monotonic per user; part of the planner input hash.

age.description: Masters guardrails start at 40. Null is allowed; the planner then avoids age-dependent assumptions.

sex.description: Used only for documented guardrails (RED-S prevalence, referral thresholds) and never for performance claims. 'unspecified' selects the conservative branch.

background.description: Trusted self-report about current capacity. The planner uses the conservative reading when history and evidence disagree.

currentWeeklyKm.description: What they ACTUALLY did recently, not what they aspire to.

consecutiveWeeksConsistent.description: Weeks at ~this volume. Drives restart-vs-progress decisions after layoff.

expiresAt.description: Prediction validity decays; default 12 months, 6 months after a layoff > 3 weeks.

priorStructuredTraining.description: A layoff after structured training restarts differently than a first build.

availability.description: The highest-leverage input in the system. A plan placed on days the runner cannot train is wrong before intensity is considered.

hardDaysAllowed.description: Structural ceiling, independent of goal. Most amateurs: 1–2.

nonNegotiableDays.description: The long run the runner will actually protect. Max 2 per week (planner rule).

travelZones.description: Present for travel: enables jet-lag-aware placement (calendar-and-time.md#3).

type.description: 'fitness-maintenance' and 'return-to-running' have no race and therefore no taper phase.

targetStatement.description: Runner's words, e.g. 'sub-4:00 marathon'. Never converted into a promise by the narrator.

outcomeStatement.description: What success means if the time does not happen. Used by reviews to choose between options.

planStyle.description: Flexible = fewer non-negotiables, more alternates, softer triggers.

riskAppetite.description: Selects a knob band, never disables a safety rule (safety-layer.md).

health.description: Classification: health-sensitive. Excluded from analytics and from any LLM prompt body (codes only, ADR-0006).

pregnancyPostpartum.description: Selects the postpartum-return persona and its guardrails; diastasis/pelvic-floor guidance is referral-only.

heatExposureDaily.description: Outdoor work / hot climate: heat pacing guardrails become structural, not advisory.

measurement.description: Directly measured anchors only. Derived values live in pace_estimates with confidence + expiry, so a plan never silently inherits a stale formula.

hrMax.description: Must be measured, not predicted: formula HRmax carries ~±9 bpm error (PHYS bibliography).

timezone.description: IANA zone name. Never an offset.

aiNarratorEnabled.description: Consent gate (ADR-0006). false = deterministic template narrator; identical content, different phrasing.

nudgeWallTime.description: Wall time in the user's zone; survives DST changes (calendar-and-time.md#5).

dislikes.description: Honoured within the session-allocation pass; adherence beats elegance.
